column2: At morning arrival, Mia takes Leo through a connecting doorway while Jordan helps another child. Mia says, “I thought you had him,” and Jordan replies, “I thought you were staying.” Leo is not yet marked on the receiving group's list.
column3: 早晨入园时，Mia把Leo带过相连教室的门，Jordan正在帮助另一名孩子。Mia说：“我以为你接手了。”Jordan回答：“我以为你还在看着。”接收组的名单还没标明Leo。

column2: One child needs urgent help in the bathroom while the others are playing in a separate area. The caregiver plans to step away and says, “They know the routine; I will only be a minute.” No one has confirmed how both areas will remain supervised.
column3: 一名孩子急需成人陪同如厕，其他孩子仍在另一个区域玩。照护者准备离开，说：“他们都熟悉流程，我去一分钟就回来。”两处怎样同时有人照看，还没有说清。

column2: After outdoor play, the head count matches the number written on the board. The attendance list still includes a child picked up earlier, and the group has not been checked child by child. A worker says, “The total is right, so there is no need to start again.”
column3: 户外活动回来后，总人数与白板上的数字一致。但名单还包括一名早已被接走的孩子，员工也没有逐名核对。有人说：“总数对了，不用重新查。”

column2: A delivery arrives while two families are asking questions at the entrance. The caregiver turns toward the door, leaving part of the play area out of view. A child begins moving toward the open passage as the caregiver continues the conversation.
column3: 快递到门口时，两户家庭也在询问事情。照护者转身处理，活动区一部分离开了视线。一名孩子开始走向敞开的通道，成人仍在继续谈话。

column2: A family asks for an extra day of care and wants an answer now. The schedule shows an empty space, but nobody has checked the actual ages, staff qualifications or license conditions for that day. A worker says, “One extra child should be fine.”
column3: 家长临时想多送一天，希望当场得到答复。排班表似乎还有空位，但那天实际的年龄组合、人员资格和许可条件尚未核对。员工说：“只多一个，应该没事。”

column2: A child's birthday falls this week. A worker immediately moves the child into an older age category on the staffing sheet and plans to reduce coverage. The program has not checked whether the applicable rule allows that change on that date.
column3: 一名孩子这周过生日。员工立刻在人员安排表上把他改到较大年龄组，并准备减少看护人员。机构还没查明，现行规则是否允许当天这样调整。

column2: A provider's relative asks to leave a child at the care site for the afternoon. The provider leaves the child off the capacity calculation, explaining, “Family does not count.” The actual household and related-child counting rules have not been reviewed.
column3: 经营者的亲属想把孩子留在照护场所一下午。经营者计算人数时没有列入，说：“亲戚家的不算。”相关的住户和亲属儿童计算规则尚未核对。

column2: Near closing, staff combine children from two groups in one room. The total attendance is low, but the combined ages, room approval and available qualified staff have not been checked. One adult also wants to leave to handle a delivery.
column3: 临近关门，员工把两个组的孩子合到同一房间。总出勤不多，但合班后的年龄、房间使用条件和合格人员尚未核对。一位成人还想离开去签收送货。

column2: A substitute arrives with a submitted background-check application but no confirmed authorization for the proposed duties. The schedule counts the person as coverage and includes a period alone with children. The substitute says, “Someone can keep an eye on me at first.”
column3: 代班人员已提交背景审查申请，却还没确认是否获准承担拟安排的职责。排班已经把他算作看护人员，还安排了一段独自带孩子的时间。他说：“刚开始有人看着我就行。”

column2: An experienced assistant is asked to act as director while the usual director is away. The assistant knows the daily routines, but the program has not compared the person's records with director qualifications. Staff assume that years of experience settle the issue.
column3: 主管不在时，一名有经验的助理被安排代理主管。她熟悉日常工作，但机构尚未把她的证明与主管任职条件对照。大家觉得，做了很多年就应该没有问题。

column2: A volunteer offers to stay when a scheduled worker leaves. Staff add the volunteer to the staffing count without checking qualifications or permitted duties. The volunteer is also asked to escort a child away from the main group.
column3: 一名志愿者愿意在员工离开后留下帮忙。大家没有查资格和允许职责，就把他算入人员配备，还请他单独带一名孩子离开主活动区。

column2: An applicant presents a credential issued in another state. The hiring file contains the certificate but no confirmation of local recognition or additional requirements. The proposed start date assumes that the credential transfers automatically.
column3: 应聘者提交外州签发的资格证明。档案中有证书，却没有当地认可或补充要求的确认。拟定的入职安排默认这张证明可以直接通用。

column2: During a schedule review, the director finds that a required training record has expired. The worker is still assigned to a shift that relies on that qualification. Someone suggests leaving the schedule unchanged because renewal has been booked.
column3: 检查排班时，园长发现一项所需培训证明已过期，这名员工仍被安排在需要该资格的时段。有人建议不要改排班，因为已经预约续训。

column2: A worker submits an online course certificate. The title sounds relevant, but nobody has checked the provider, delivery format or whether the course meets the required training category. The file is about to be marked complete.
column3: 员工提交一张网课结业证。课程名称看起来相关，但培训机构、上课形式和是否符合所需类别都没有核对。档案马上要被标成已完成。

column2: The only worker with a particular required qualification is scheduled to go off site for a break. The replacement plan lists a familiar coworker whose relevant qualification has not been confirmed. Staff say the break is too short to matter.
column3: 唯一具备某项所需资格的员工准备离开场所休息。替班表写了熟悉的同事，但该同事的相关资格尚未确认。大家认为休息时间短，不会有影响。

column2: A new worker can describe meals and rest time but cannot identify the emergency exit or locate the live attendance list. The worker is due to take independent responsibility later that day. Orientation has been signed off without a demonstration.
column3: 新员工能说出吃饭和午休时间，却找不到应急出口和当天实际名单。当天稍后他就要独立承担工作，入职培训表却已在没有演示的情况下签完。

column2: During a routine check, a worker sees a stuffed toy in an infant's sleep space. The infant has no signs of distress in this example. The parent says the same toy is always used at home and asks that it stay.
column3: 日常查看时，员工发现婴儿睡眠区域里有毛绒玩具。本例中婴儿没有异常表现。家长说家里一直这样用，希望机构也保留。

column2: An infant falls asleep in a swing during the morning routine. A worker wants to leave the infant there rather than risk waking them. The equipment has not been established as an appropriate infant sleep surface.
column3: 晨间活动中，一名婴儿在摇椅里睡着了。员工担心转移会把孩子弄醒，想让他继续睡。但该设备并未被确认可作为婴儿睡眠表面。

column2: The video monitor is on while infants sleep, but one view is partly blocked. A worker stops making the required direct checks, saying the camera will show any problem. The observation record does not reflect what was actually checked.
column3: 婴儿睡眠时监控器开着，其中一个画面有遮挡。员工认为设备能显示问题，就停止了该做的直接查看。观察记录也没能反映实际检查情况。

column2: A parent asks for an infant sleep arrangement that differs from the program's safety procedure. The family has not supplied the documentation needed to assess any medical exception. A worker wants to accept the request after obtaining a parent signature.
column3: 家长要求采用与机构安全做法不同的婴儿睡眠安排，但尚未提供判断医疗例外所需的资料。员工想让家长签个字就同意。

column2: A parent brings routine medication and says, “Give a little after lunch.” The written instructions are incomplete, and the assigned worker has not confirmed the required authorization. The parent is in a hurry to leave.
column3: 家长带来常规药物，说：“午饭后给一点。”书面说明不完整，执行员工也没核实所需授权。家长赶着离开。

column2: Two similar medicine bottles are stored next to each other. A worker reaches for one based on its color, while the child-specific label and administration record remain unread. Another adult says the bottles are always kept in the same order.
column3: 两瓶外观相似的药放在一起。员工凭颜色拿起其中一瓶，没有读儿童标签和给药记录。同事说，药瓶一直按固定顺序摆放。

column2: The medication record is blank for a scheduled dose, but a coworker thinks it may already have been given. The child has no urgent symptoms in this example. Someone suggests giving it now so that the record will no longer be incomplete.
column3: 计划给药时间的记录空着，同事却觉得可能已经给过。本例中孩子没有紧急症状。有人建议现在补一次，让记录不再空缺。

column2: A readiness check finds that the child's emergency medicine cannot be located quickly. Staff also disagree about who has been trained to use it. There is no active medical emergency during this check.
column3: 准备检查时，员工无法很快找到孩子的急救药，也说不清谁接受过相关培训。检查当时并没有正在发生的医疗急症。

column2: A visitor brings cookies with no reliable ingredient information. One child has an allergy plan, and a checked alternative snack is available. A worker suggests removing visible nuts and serving the cookie anyway.
column3: 访客带来没有可靠配料说明的饼干。一名孩子有过敏计划，机构也有已核实合适的替代点心。员工提议挑掉看得见的坚果后照常供应。

column2: A serving spoon moves from one food into another child's meal. Staff know the foods have different allergen ingredients but have not checked whether the second meal is affected. Someone says a clean spoon will fix the problem.
column3: 一把勺子从一种食物移到另一名孩子的餐食中。员工知道两份食物所含过敏原不同，却未核对第二份是否已受影响。有人说换一把干净勺子就行。

column2: A perishable food has been left outside controlled storage. No reliable time or temperature record establishes how long it has been there. It looks and smells normal, so the team is considering serving it.
column3: 一份需要控温保存的食物离开储存设备，却没有可靠的时间和温度资料。它看起来、闻起来都正常，员工正考虑继续供应。

column2: A family sends an updated meal instruction to the office. The adult preparing and serving lunch has not received it, and the old meal list remains in use. The office considers the change complete because the message was filed.
column3: 家庭把新的饮食说明发给办公室，但备餐和上餐成人没收到，旧名单还在使用。办公室觉得消息已经归档，变更就算完成。

column2: A child arrives looking unusually tired and uncomfortable. Staff have not assessed the observed symptoms or whether the child's needs can be met safely. The parent wants an immediate yes-or-no decision at the door.
column3: 孩子到园时明显疲倦、不舒服。员工还没看清症状，也没判断现有照护能否满足需要。家长希望在门口立刻得到能否入园的答复。

column2: A child becomes ill during group activities while the other children still need supervision. A worker suggests placing the child alone in a separate room until pickup. The family says they cannot arrive immediately.
column3: 集体活动中一名孩子生病了，其他孩子仍需要看护。员工提议让他独自在另一房间等接送，家长表示不能马上到。

column2: A return-to-care message says only that the child is “better.” The program has not checked whether the message addresses its actual return criteria or current health direction. Staff disagree about whether the note settles the matter.
column3: 返园信息只写孩子“好多了”。机构没核对这句话是否满足实际返园条件或现行卫生指导，员工对能否据此接收意见不一。

column2: Several families report similar symptoms over a short period. The program has recorded some messages but has not assembled a timeline or checked notification duties. A worker proposes waiting until a diagnosis is certain before seeking guidance.
column3: 短时间内多户家庭报告相似症状。机构保存了部分消息，但尚未整理时间线或核对通知责任。员工提议等诊断确定后再咨询。

column2: A child is already on the changing surface when the caregiver discovers the supplies are across the room. The caregiver plans to walk away briefly. Another child also needs attention nearby.
column3: 孩子已经在换尿布台上，照护者才发现用品放在房间另一侧。他准备短暂走开，旁边另一个孩子也需要帮助。

column2: A caregiver finishes toileting assistance and moves toward food preparation without completing hand hygiene. The caregiver says gloves were worn and the hands look clean. Group supervision is available while the hygiene steps are completed.
column3: 照护者帮助孩子如厕后，没有完成手部卫生就准备处理食物。他说戴过手套，手也不脏。此时可以安排他完成洗手，而不影响孩子的看护。

column2: A personal-care surface is proposed as a temporary food-preparation area. Someone wipes it once and assumes that is enough. Neither permitted use nor the necessary cleaning treatment has been checked.
column3: 有人想把个人照护台面临时用来备餐，擦过一次就觉得可以。这个区域是否允许备餐、应怎样处理，都没有核对。

column2: A toileting screen prevents unnecessary viewing but also blocks the caregiver's ability to provide required supervision. Staff want to keep the arrangement unchanged because it protects privacy. No alternative layout has been considered.
column3: 如厕遮挡物保护了隐私，也挡住了照护者必要的观察。员工想保持原状，认为保护隐私更重要，却没考虑其他布局。

column2: An unlabeled spray bottle is found on the supply shelf. A worker thinks it is the usual cleaner but cannot confirm the contents. The worker proposes smelling it and writing a new label from memory.
column3: 用品架上发现一只无标签喷瓶。员工觉得是平时的清洁剂，却无法确认，想闻一下再凭记忆贴新标签。

column2: A worker proposes mixing two cleaning products to make them stronger. The product directions do not authorize that mixture. Children are scheduled to enter the room soon.
column3: 员工想把两种清洁产品混在一起加强效果，标签并没有这种用法。孩子很快就要进入房间。

column2: A surface is sprayed and immediately wiped dry. Nobody has checked the product's required wet contact time or full use directions. The task is marked complete because the surface looks clean.
column3: 员工喷过表面后立刻擦干，没有核对标签要求的湿润接触时间和完整步骤。因为看起来干净，工作就被标为完成。

column2: Cleaning products remain within children's reach after a rushed task. The team has not checked whether any child touched the containers. Someone moves the products away and considers the incident finished.
column3: 匆忙清洁后，产品留在孩子够得到的地方。员工没查是否有孩子碰过，只把瓶子移走，就认为事情结束了。

column2: A routine check finds furniture blocking a planned exit. Staff have not confirmed an alternative route or who will maintain supervision while the obstruction is removed. Someone says they can move it if a fire actually occurs.
column3: 日常检查发现家具挡住预定出口。大家没确认其他路线，也没安排移物时谁看孩子。有人说真着火了再搬也来得及。

column2: The emergency contact list contains disconnected numbers. A recent family change is still only in a message thread. Staff have not tested the agreed backup communication method.
column3: 紧急联系表里有停用号码，家庭最近的变更仍只留在聊天消息里。约定的备用通信方法也没检查是否可用。

column2: The emergency kit was prepared before several children enrolled. Some current individual care needs are not reflected in the supplies or staff instructions. The checklist is signed because the bag is still on the shelf.
column3: 应急包是在几名新孩子入园前准备的，现在部分个人照护需要没有反映到物品和员工说明中。因为包还在架上，清单照常被签完。

column2: During a drill, two adults direct families to different reunification locations. The release list is not available at either location. Staff assume that familiar faces make a formal release check unnecessary.
column3: 演练时，两名成人把家庭指向不同集合地点，两个地方都没有接走名单。员工觉得家长都认识，不必正式核对交接。

column2: A mark is noticed on a child, but nobody witnessed when it appeared. Staff offer different guesses about its cause. One person wants to record a likely accident as if it were observed.
column3: 员工发现孩子身上有印记，却没人见到何时出现。大家各自猜原因，有人想把“可能是撞的”写成亲眼见到的事实。

column2: An incident received immediate attention, but nobody assigned the follow-up notifications. The parent heard an informal account, and staff assume that covers all reporting. The program has not checked the event-specific recipients or deadlines.
column3: 事件得到即时处理，却没人负责后续通知。家长听到口头说明后，员工觉得所有报告都完成了，实际对象和时限并未核对。

column2: A child nearly reaches an unsafe exit but is stopped before injury. The team calls it a harmless near-miss and leaves the defective latch in use. No one is assigned to verify a correction.
column3: 孩子差点从不安全出口出去，被及时拦住而没有受伤。员工觉得只是小险情，坏门闩继续使用，也没人负责确认修复。

column2: Two witnesses give different accounts of the same event. Someone suggests producing one agreed version before any record or report is made. The child's care needs and any time-sensitive reporting duties have not been separately addressed.
column3: 两名目击者对同一事件说法不同。有人建议先统一版本再记录或报告，却没有另外处理孩子照护和可能有时限的报告责任。

column2: During play, a child says, “Someone hurt me last night.” The caregiver is unsure what happened and wants to help. A coworker suggests questioning other children first to see whether the account can be proved.
column3: 游戏时，孩子说：“昨晚有人弄疼我。”照护者不知道具体经过，想帮忙。同事建议先问其他孩子，看能否证明。

column2: A worker has a concern that may trigger protective reporting. The owner says all outside calls need approval and asks the worker to wait until the next morning. The worker has not yet used the official reporting route.
column3: 员工遇到可能触发保护性报告的情况。经营者说所有对外电话要先批准，希望等到第二天。员工尚未通过官方渠道处理。

column2: Staff share details of a protective concern in a general chat that includes people without an authorized role. Someone argues that all coworkers should know everything. The necessary reporting process is being discussed alongside casual speculation.
column3: 员工在普通群里分享保护性事件细节，其中有人并无处理职责。有人认为同事都应该知道全部情况，正式报告与闲聊猜测混在一起。

column2: A caregiver is uncertain whether the known facts meet the reporting threshold. A colleague advises gathering enough proof before contacting anyone. No official reporting guidance has yet been consulted.
column3: 照护者拿不准已知事实是否达到报告门槛。同事建议证据足够了再联系，大家还没向官方报告渠道确认要求。

column2: An adult proposes having the group call a child “naughty” to stop repeated behavior. Another worker feels uncomfortable but says the method may work quickly. No supportive alternative has been planned.
column3: 成人提议让全组说一个孩子“很坏”，以制止反复行为。另一位员工虽不舒服，却觉得这样可能见效快，尚未准备支持性的替代做法。

column2: Two children repeatedly clash while waiting in a crowded transition area. Staff repeat the same warning but leave the long wait and crowded arrangement unchanged. One worker wants to label the children as the problem.
column3: 两个孩子总在拥挤的过渡区等待时起冲突。员工重复同样警告，却不改变等待和拥挤安排。有人想直接把原因归为孩子难管。

column2: A worker wants to use a physical-control method they have not been trained to perform. The limits and reporting requirements are unclear. Other children are nearby as the situation escalates.
column3: 员工想用一种未受过训练的身体控制方法，也不清楚限制和报告要求。情况正在升级，其他孩子就在旁边。

column2: The behavior record says only, “Ava was bad again.” A witness actually saw a peer take a truck, followed by Ava pushing a block toward that child. The adult response and outcome are missing.
column3: 行为记录只写“Ava又很坏”。目击者实际看到的是，同伴拿走小车后，Ava把积木推向对方。成人回应和结果没有写。

column2: A worker proposes ending a child's enrollment immediately after repeated difficulties. The program has not assembled incident records, reviewed individual supports or discussed the pattern fully with the family. The decision is being treated as ordinary paperwork.
column3: 孩子多次遇到困难后，员工提议立即结束入园。机构还没整理事件记录、审查个人支持或与家庭完整讨论，却把决定当成普通手续。

column2: A family requests a change that would help a child participate in a routine activity. The worker rejects it because the usual routine would need to change. No individualized discussion or trial has taken place.
column3: 家庭提出一种帮助孩子参与日常活动的调整，员工因惯例要改变而拒绝。双方尚未作个人讨论，也没有试行。

column2: A worker is assigned to implement an individual care plan but has not received the necessary instructions. A coworker says the plan is confidential and therefore cannot be shared at all. The handoff is due shortly.
column3: 员工被安排执行个人照护计划，却没收到必要说明。同事说计划保密，所以完全不能分享。交接马上就要发生。

column2: A child is repeatedly sent home early after difficult transitions. Each event is described as a one-off favor rather than a change in attendance. The program has not reviewed the combined pattern or tried a documented support plan.
column3: 孩子在困难转场后反复被要求提前回家。每次都称临时安排，没有被当作出勤变化审查，也没有记录并试行支持计划。

column2: An unfamiliar adult arrives with identification and says the parent approved pickup. The current authorized-release information does not yet confirm that claim. A worker wants to release the child because the adult seems confident.
column3: 陌生成人带着证件来接孩子，说家长已经同意。当前授权资料还不能确认这句话。员工觉得对方说得很肯定，想直接放行。

column2: The child has left, but the attendance system still shows the child present. Staff remember an approximate departure time, not an exact one. Someone suggests entering a convenient time so the record looks complete.
column3: 孩子已经离园，系统仍显示在场。员工只记得大概时间，有人建议填一个方便的数字，让记录完整。

column2: A pickup adult presents information that conflicts with the program's custody records. Staff do not know which document is current. The adult insists that a familiar relationship should settle the issue.
column3: 接送成人提供的资料与机构监护记录冲突。员工不知道哪份现行有效，对方坚持说大家熟悉，就应该相信他。

column2: Closing time has passed, and one child remains. The scheduled coverage is ending, and authorized contacts have not yet been reached. A worker proposes leaving the child with an unapproved helper or driving the child home informally.
column3: 关门时间已过，仍有一个孩子在园。排定人手要下班，授权联系人还没联系上。员工提议交给未获准帮手，或私下开车送回家。

column2: Before departure, the transport roster does not match the actual passengers. Staff are unsure whether the discrepancy is a record error or a child in the wrong group. The driver says it can be sorted out on arrival.
column3: 出发前，运输名单与实际乘客不符。员工不知道是记录错误，还是孩子上错组。司机说可以到达后再查。

column2: After unloading, a worker assumes the vehicle is empty because it is quiet. The assigned physical check has not been completed, and the checklist is still blank. Staff outside are also busy settling the group.
column3: 孩子下车后，员工因为车里安静就认为已经无人。实车检查未完成，清单仍空着，车外员工也正忙着安顿全组。

column2: A child restraint is available, but nobody has checked its fit for the child or installation in this vehicle. The worker relies on an age-based guess. The trip is due to start shortly.
column3: 车上有儿童约束装置，但没人核对是否适合孩子、在本车安装是否正确。员工只凭年龄猜测，行程很快就要开始。

column2: A substitute driver is found after a last-minute absence. The person drives a private car regularly, but the program has not checked the proposed transport role or required records. The team wants to avoid canceling the trip.
column3: 司机临时缺席，机构找到代班。对方常开私家车，但本次运输岗位和所需证明都没核对。团队不想取消行程。

column2: A damaged playground component remains accessible during outdoor play. Staff have verbally warned the children but have not blocked access. The repair request has been sent, and someone considers that sufficient.
column3: 户外活动时，损坏的游乐设备仍可接触。员工口头提醒过，却没实际阻隔。维修申请已发出，有人认为这样就够了。

column2: An outdoor activity is about to begin using yesterday's weather information. Current alerts and the program's weather plan have not been checked. Staff do not have an agreed indoor alternative.
column3: 户外活动准备开始，员工看的却是昨天的信息。当前警报和天气安排没查，也没有商量好的室内替代活动。

column2: Children are drawn toward a water feature outside the planned play area. No activity-specific supervision, barrier or rescue arrangement has been confirmed. A worker says the feature is decorative, not a swimming pool.
column3: 孩子被计划活动区外的水景吸引。相关看护、阻隔和救援安排尚未确认。员工认为只是装饰，不是游泳池。

column2: The outing destination changes after staff and families reviewed the original plan. The new site is nearby but has different access and facilities. The team assumes the old permission and staffing arrangements automatically carry over.
column3: 员工和家庭看过原计划后，外出地点改变了。新地点虽近，出入条件和设施却不同。团队默认旧授权和人员安排自动适用。

column2: A storage unit rocks when a child pulls on it. Staff plan to tell children not to touch it until maintenance arrives. The area remains open, and no one has verified a suitable stabilization method.
column3: 孩子拉动储物柜时，柜体晃动。员工计划在维修到来前提醒孩子别碰，区域仍开放，也没有确认正确固定方法。

column2: A utility failure affects drinking water, hygiene or room conditions. Staff have not checked which safe-care functions can still operate. One person assumes care can continue because the building is still open.
column3: 水电故障影响饮水、卫生或室内条件。员工没查哪些安全照护功能还能维持，只因楼门还开着就认为可以照常。

column2: A newly available room is used for children before its approved use and capacity are confirmed. It looks spacious, but relevant safety checks are incomplete. The usual room is busy, so staff want to keep using it.
column3: 新空出来的房间在用途和人数条件未确认前就开始带孩子。看起来宽敞，但相关安全检查没完成。因为原房间忙，员工想继续使用。

column2: Maintenance during care creates dust, exposed tools and an open route through the work area. Staff rely on verbal warnings instead of separation. The team has not reviewed any building-specific environmental concerns.
column3: 照护期间维修产生灰尘、外露工具和穿过工区的通道。员工只作口头提醒，没有分开区域，也未审查该建筑可能涉及的环境问题。

column2: A household visitor enters an area used for residential child care. The provider has not checked access restrictions or explained the visitor's permitted role. Another adult assumes the visitor can briefly watch the children.
column3: 住宅托育期间，家庭访客走进照护区域。经营者没核对接触限制，也没说清允许职责。另一成人认为访客可以暂时带一下孩子。

column2: A new adult moves into a home used for child care. The provider treats it as a private household change and has not checked screening or notification duties. The resident will have access to parts of the care environment.
column3: 经营家庭托育的住所搬入一名新成人。经营者把这看成私事，尚未核对审查或通知责任。新住户能进入部分照护环境。

column2: An animal interaction is proposed without reviewing health, handling, supervision or individual child needs. Staff assume the animal's familiar behavior is enough. A handwashing arrangement has not been prepared.
column3: 机构想安排孩子接触动物，却没审查健康、接触方式、看护或个人需要。员工觉得动物平时温顺就够了，也没准备洗手安排。

column2: A household item presenting a serious hazard is found in a care-accessible area. A worker places it on a higher shelf but has not checked the correct storage method. A child could still reach the area with nearby furniture.
column3: 照护区域发现严重危险物。员工把它移到高架，却没查正确保管方法，孩子借旁边家具仍可能够到。

column2: Several workers share a login for child records. A disputed entry cannot be traced to the actual editor, and password access has spread informally. The team wants a fix but has not separated software choices from legal record duties.
column3: 几名员工共用儿童记录账号，一处争议修改找不到实际操作人，密码也被随意转发。团队想改进，却没分清软件选择和法律记录责任。

column2: A photo is proposed for public promotion even though the recorded permission concerns a private family update. The intended audience and use have changed. Staff think any signed photo form is enough.
column3: 一张照片拟用于公开宣传，原同意却只涉及私人家庭更新。使用对象和用途已经变了，员工认为只要签过任何照片表就够。

column2: An enrollment file has a missing item, but staff have not identified whether it affects emergency care, legal attendance or only an optional activity. The team proposes one blanket response for every incomplete file.
column3: 入园档案有缺项，但员工没分清它影响急救、合法出勤，还是可选活动。团队准备对所有不完整档案采取同一种处理。

column2: Storage space is tight, and someone proposes deleting all older records. No one has checked the record categories, retention periods or legal holds. The deletion is being treated as ordinary housekeeping.
column3: 存储空间紧张，有人提议删除所有旧资料。记录类别、保存期限和法律保留都没查，删除被当成普通清理。

column2: A subsidy claim and original attendance evidence differ. Staff do not yet know whether the issue concerns authorization, a payment rule or an entry error. Someone proposes changing attendance to match the claim.
column3: 补助申报与原始出勤不符。员工不知道问题来自授权、付款规则还是录入错误，有人提议把出勤改到与申报一样。

column2: A subsidy authorization changes, but billing continues using the previous information. The effective date has not been matched to the billing period. The bookkeeper wants to overwrite the old entry rather than document a correction.
column3: 补助授权已变，账单仍用旧资料。生效日期还没与账期对应，记账人员想覆盖旧记录，而不是留下更正。

column2: A provider hears that another program pays for all absences. The provider's own current authorization and payment terms have not been read. A claim is being prepared using that assumption.
column3: 经营者听说别的项目所有缺勤都付款，却没读自己的现行授权和付款条款，就准备按这个假设申报。

column2: A family charge is proposed to cover a subsidy payment gap. The agreement and permitted fees have not been checked, and the family has not received a verified explanation. The fee is described as routine administration.
column3: 机构想向家庭加费以补补助款差额，却没查协议和允许费用，也没给家庭核实后的说明。这笔费用被称为普通管理费。

column2: Ownership changes while the care program continues operating. The new owner assumes the existing license transfers with the business. Approval and notification requirements have not been checked before relying on that license.
column3: 生意转让时照护继续，新经营者认为许可证会随生意一起转移。在依赖旧许可营业前，批准和通知要求都没核对。

column2: A repair invoice arrives, and a cited problem is marked corrected. Nobody has tested whether the repaired safeguard works during ordinary use. Required evidence or submissions have not yet been reviewed.
column3: 维修账单到达后，一个被指出的问题就标为已整改。没人测试修好的安全装置在日常使用中是否有效，也没检查所需证明或提交。

column2: A person presents as an inspector while the manager is absent. Staff are unsure how to verify identity and arrange lawful access. One worker proposes a manager-only rule; another wants to provide records without verification.
column3: 经理不在时，一人自称检查员到场。员工不知怎样核实和安排合法访问：有人想一律等经理，有人想不核实就交记录。

column2: Staff use a general guide while overlooking a condition on the actual license. The two appear to suggest different operating arrangements. The team wants to follow the simpler summary without asking the issuing authority.
column3: 员工照通用指南做，却忽略实际许可证条件。两者似乎指向不同安排，团队想选简单摘要，不向签发机构确认。

column2: An awake preschooler struggles with a rigid rest routine. Staff have not considered an allowed quiet alternative or the child's individual needs. Someone applies an infant-sleep example to justify the preschool arrangement.
column3: 一名醒着的学前孩子难以适应固定午休安排。员工没考虑允许的安静活动和个人需要，却拿婴儿睡眠例子来解释学前安排。

column2: A family receives an important message full of unfamiliar terms. They nod but cannot explain the next step. Staff consider communication complete because the message was sent and acknowledged.
column3: 家庭收到充满陌生词语的重要通知。家长点头，却说不出下一步做什么。员工因为消息已发送并获回应，就认为沟通完成。

column2: A child is left out of an activity because the usual tool or setup is inaccessible. No one has explored a different way to participate in the same learning goal. A worker proposes offering the child an unrelated task instead.
column3: 孩子因原工具或布置不适合而被排除，没人探索实现同一学习目标的其他参与方式。员工想给他另一个无关任务。

column2: The displayed program plan does not match the children's ordinary day. Staff repeat activities that do not serve the stated learning goals and do not revise the plan. The document is treated as inspection material rather than a working guide.
column3: 展示的课程计划与孩子实际一天不符。员工重复与目标无关的活动，也不修改计划，只把文件当检查材料。

column2: Two policy versions remain in daily use, giving different instructions. Staff cannot identify the current approved version. Someone proposes deleting every older copy without checking historical-record needs.
column3: 两版政策同时在用，说明不一致。员工不知道哪版现行有效，有人提议不查历史保留需要就把所有旧版删掉。

column2: The same operational error returns after several verbal reminders. The workflow, equipment or coverage arrangement has not changed. The director asks for a correction that can be observed and tested rather than another warning.
column3: 同一种运营错误在几次口头提醒后再现。流程、设备和人员安排都没变，园长要求一个可观察、可检查的改进，而不只是再次警告。

column2: A missed checklist is completed later using the date when the task should have happened. Staff say this will make the file look consistent. The actual completion time and any remaining risk are not documented.
column3: 漏填清单后来补写，却用本应完成的日期。员工说这样档案一致，实际完成时间和剩余危险却没记。

column2: A social-media post claims a rule changed. The effective official text and license-category coverage are not available in the file. Staff want to change practice immediately using another provider's summary.
column3: 社交媒体说规则改了，档案里没有有效官方原文和许可适用范围。员工想立即照另一经营者的摘要改变做法。
